hunks.baseline: “What the hell is with this wind? Fucking hell.”
hunks.sol: “This wind is fucking brutal. Goddamn it.”

hunks.baseline: I turned around, wondering what bizarre sound that had been, and found Hyuk Mujin rubbing his blue-tinted nose.
hunks.sol: I turned around, wondering what bizarre sound that had been, and found Hyuk Mujin rubbing his blue-tinged nose.

hunks.baseline: When our eyes met, his narrowed into hooks.
hunks.sol: When our eyes met, his eyes curved into hooks.

hunks.baseline: “What?”
hunks.sol: “What? What is it?”

hunks.baseline: “No, I was just wondering about the sound of your sneeze…”
hunks.sol: “No, I was just fascinated by the sound of your sneeze…”

hunks.baseline: “Seriously? You find even that fascinating? If you have that much time to spare, dig up another herb.”
hunks.sol: “Seriously? You find the strangest things fascinating. If you have that much time to spare, dig up another herb.”

hunks.baseline: “……All right. My bad.”
hunks.sol: “…All right. My bad.”

hunks.baseline: “Get a grip!”
hunks.sol: “Get your head in the game!”

hunks.baseline: Ugh. I couldn’t even punch him.
hunks.sol: Ugh. It wasn’t like I could punch him.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll dig for herbs beyond that hill. Don’t stop working. I’ll come check on you from time to time.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll dig for herbs beyond that hill. Don’t stop working. I’ll come back and check on you every so often.”

hunks.baseline: “……Got it, you punk.”
hunks.sol: “…Got it, you punk.”

hunks.baseline: I repeated the character for patience to myself, gently dug through the snow, and pulled up an herb.
hunks.sol: Repeating the character for patience to myself, I gently dug through the snow and pulled up an herb.

hunks.sol: The moment I placed it in the basket our exploitative employer—or rather, the Divine Physician—had issued to each of his herb slaves, a System notification rang out.

hunks.baseline: The fact that I could slowly see the end was at least some consolation.
hunks.sol: At least the finish line was coming into sight.

hunks.baseline: As I checked the Quest window to see how many remained, Gung Gibang approached me, shivering violently.
hunks.sol: As I checked the Quest window to see how much remained, Gung Gibang approached me, shivering violently.

hunks.baseline: “Two hundred roots are left?”
hunks.sol: “Two hundred roots are still left?”

hunks.baseline: “No. Two hundred roots is way too many. By then, I’ll be a frozen corpse buried somewhere under this snow.”
hunks.sol: “No. Two hundred roots is far too many. By then, I’ll be a frozen corpse buried somewhere under this snow.”

hunks.baseline: He brought his face close to the tiny flame and murmured in a wistful voice, “I miss my Master. I miss the days when I begged in the alley outside a warm inn…”
hunks.sol: He brought his face close to the tiny flame and murmured wistfully, “I miss my Master. I miss the days when I begged in the alley outside a warm inn…”

hunks.baseline: “At least I was a warm beggar back then. That’s a hundred times better than being a cold one.”
hunks.sol: “At least I was a warm beggar. That’s a hundred times better than being a cold one.”

hunks.baseline: “……You have a point.”
hunks.sol: “…You have a point.”

hunks.baseline: “I want to go back to those days. A lazy noon, sunlight pouring down. A delicious-looking yellow dog walking by…”
hunks.sol: “I want to go back to those days. A lazy noon, sunlight pouring down. A delicious-looking yellow dog strolling past…”

hunks.baseline: What the hell did he mean, a plump yellow dog?
hunks.sol: What the hell was a *delicious-looking* yellow dog?

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang’s eyelids slowly drooped as he said something that would make animal-protection groups scream.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang’s eyelids slowly drooped after he said something that would make any animal-protection group scream.

hunks.baseline: I continued sending Scorching Yang Qi into him and shouted, “Is anyone there? Somebody, come here, quick!”
hunks.sol: I continued sending Scorching Yang Qi into him and shouted, “Is anyone there? Somebody get over here, quick!”

hunks.baseline: “Nice, Cheongpung! Quickly, take this guy outside—”
hunks.sol: “Nice, Cheongpung! Quick, take this guy outside—”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician checked all the herbs in the baskets and nodded.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician inspected all the herbs in the baskets and nodded.

hunks.baseline: Look at that achievement title.
hunks.sol: Just look at that achievement title.

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician’s gaze, which had been resting on our utterly exhausted forms, suddenly stopped on one person.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician looked over our utterly exhausted group before his gaze suddenly stopped on one person.

hunks.baseline: That was because I had smashed the first snowman Cheongpung had ever made with my Flame Divine Palm.
hunks.sol: Because I had smashed the first snowman Cheongpung had ever made with my Flame Divine Palm.

hunks.baseline: “They are. With this quantity, we will be prepared for whatever may happen later.”
hunks.sol: “They are. With this quantity, we will be prepared for anything that may happen later.”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician nodded heavily.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician nodded gravely.

hunks.baseline: I suddenly realized something I had forgotten for a moment.
hunks.sol: I suddenly realized something I had forgotten.

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician had never once been certain.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician had never once expressed certainty.

hunks.baseline: He had only seen a possibility and said that he would do his best.
hunks.sol: He had only seen a possibility and promised to do his best.

hunks.baseline: “Please… do everything you can. Do everything you can.”
hunks.sol: “Please… Please do your very best.”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong, who had been standing beside the Divine Physician, spoke with resolve.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong, who stood beside the Divine Physician, spoke with conviction.

hunks.baseline: “There’s no need. It is only natural for a medical apprentice to do so.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t mention it. It is only natural for a medical apprentice.”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician remained silent for a moment, thinking.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician considered the question for a moment before answering.

hunks.baseline: “Probably in seven days. Until then, Mungyeong and I will combine and refine the twenty-four types of herbs you brought us and prepare them as ingredients for the Life-Restoring Great Technique.”
hunks.sol: “Probably in seven days and nights. Until then, Mungyeong and I will combine and refine the twenty-four types of herbs you brought us, preparing them as ingredients for the Life-Restoring Great Technique.”

hunks.baseline: “This is only a portion of what we need. Fortunately, I already possess the remaining ingredients required for the Life-Restoring Great Technique, which allowed us to shorten the preparation time.”
hunks.sol: “This is only a portion of what we need. Fortunately, I already possess the remaining ingredients required for the Life-Restoring Great Technique, which has allowed us to shorten the preparation time.”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician stroked his snow-white beard and answered.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician stroked his snow-white beard.

hunks.baseline: “As I mentioned before, my Master was once a martial artist. He primarily practiced medicine among the common people, but he was also deeply learned in the proper management of qi.”
hunks.sol: “As I mentioned before, my Master was once a martial artist. He primarily practiced medicine among the common people, but he was also deeply versed in controlling qi.”

hunks.baseline: Hearing that, I had a rough idea of where this was going.
hunks.sol: Hearing that, I had a rough idea where this was going.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin suddenly cut in with a gasp.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin suddenly cut in with an exclamation.

hunks.baseline: “A martial artist! So the Life-Restoring Great Technique was created to treat martial artists!”
hunks.sol: “Martial artists! The Life-Restoring Great Technique was created to treat martial artists!”

hunks.baseline: “That is correct. Master of Strange Illusions was one of them. He recovered from severe qi deviation thanks to the Life-Restoring Great Technique, then installed a Mystic Gate Formation before departing.”
hunks.sol: “That is correct. The Master of Strange Illusions was one of them. After recovering from severe qi deviation thanks to the Life-Restoring Great Technique, he installed the Mystic Gate Formation for us before departing.”

hunks.baseline: For martial artists, qi deviation was practically a death sentence. Their internal energy reversed course, their qi and blood became tangled, and all their acupoints and dantian were damaged.
hunks.sol: For a martial artist, qi deviation was practically a death sentence. Their internal energy would flow backward, their qi and blood would become tangled, and all sorts of acupoints along with the dantian would be damaged.

hunks.baseline: *But he cured qi deviation.*
hunks.sol: *And the technique cured that?*

hunks.sol: If the Master of Strange Illusions had suffered qi deviation severe enough for the Divine Physician to describe it that way, he must have been little more than a walking corpse at the time.

hunks.baseline: Even just hearing about it gave me some idea of how effective the Life-Restoring Great Technique was.
hunks.sol: Just hearing the story gave me some idea of how effective the Life-Restoring Great Technique was.

hunks.baseline: I quickly brushed the thought aside.
hunks.sol: I quickly shook off the thought before it could finish forming.

hunks.baseline: There was no reason to be certain now, and no reason to worry.
hunks.sol: There was no reason to be certain yet, nor any need to worry.

hunks.baseline: “By then, the preparation of the Life-Restoring Great Technique will be finished, and we will have a clearer understanding of the patient’s condition. Wait patiently until then.”
hunks.sol: “By then, the Life-Restoring Great Technique will be ready, and we should have a clearer understanding of the patient’s condition. Please wait patiently until then.”

hunks.baseline: “I will keep that in mind.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll keep that in mind.”

hunks.baseline: “Remember. Seven days.”
hunks.sol: “Remember. Seven days and nights.”

hunks.baseline: But the Divine Physician’s words did not come true.
hunks.sol: But the Divine Physician was unable to keep his word.

hunks.baseline: “……What is it?”
hunks.sol: “…What is it?”

hunks.baseline: “There is an unidentified, extremely deadly poison inside the patient’s body. That was the real cause.”
hunks.sol: “There is an unidentified, extremely deadly poison inside the patient’s body. That was the true cause.”

hunks.baseline: My thoughts became tangled and chaotic.
hunks.sol: My thoughts twisted into a chaotic knot.

hunks.baseline: “What does this mean?”
hunks.sol: “What does that mean?”

hunks.baseline: “It means exactly what you heard.”
hunks.sol: “Exactly what you heard.”

hunks.baseline: “While preparing the technique and examining the patient’s condition, I discovered something strange. The Scorching Yang Qi, which should have been growing more rampant, was gradually subsiding.”
hunks.sol: “While preparing the technique and monitoring the patient’s condition, I discovered something strange. The Scorching Yang Qi, which should have been growing more rampant, was gradually subsiding.”

hunks.baseline: “Then isn’t that a good thing? Suddenly bringing up poison—what does that have to do with anything…?”
hunks.sol: “Then isn’t that a good thing? What does some sudden poison have to do with—”

hunks.baseline: “The technique has not even been performed yet. How could the Scorching Yang Qi be decreasing on its own?”
hunks.sol: “We have not even performed the technique yet. How could the Scorching Yang Qi be decreasing on its own?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s…”
hunks.sol: “That…”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, a thought suddenly flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a thought flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: On the journey from Henan to Sichuan, I had periodically stabilized Jeok Cheongang’s qi with True Qi Guidance. Yet contrary to what I had been doing, Jeok Cheongang’s Scorching Yang Qi had continued to diminish.
hunks.sol: During our journey from Henan to Sichuan, I had periodically stabilized Jeok Cheongang’s qi with True Qi Guidance. Yet despite my efforts, his Scorching Yang Qi had continued to diminish.

hunks.baseline: “When one type of energy gains the upper hand, the energy opposite it naturally grows weaker. But the patient was different. His Yin-Cold Qi remained unchanged, while his Scorching Yang Qi was gradually dwindling.”
hunks.sol: “When one type of energy gains the upper hand, the opposing energy naturally diminishes. But the patient was different. His Yin-Cold Qi remained unchanged, while his Scorching Yang Qi was gradually dwindling.”

hunks.baseline: “I do not know how it happened, but a Formless Ultimate Poison was hidden inside the patient’s body—one that even I would not dare touch. Whether it was a blessing or a misfortune, if the Scorching Yang Qi had not happened to wrap around the poison while it was running wild and played the role of using poison to control poison, he would have melted into a handful of blood long ago.”
hunks.sol: “I do not know how it happened, but a Formless Ultimate Poison lies hidden within the patient’s body—one that even I would not dare touch. Whether by great fortune or terrible misfortune, the rampaging Scorching Yang Qi happened to envelop the Formless Ultimate Poison and counteract it like poison against poison. Otherwise, he would have melted into a handful of bloody liquid long ago.”

hunks.baseline: I did not know when or how the poison the Divine Physician called Formless Ultimate Poison had entered Jeok Cheongang’s body.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know when or how the poison the Divine Physician called Formless Ultimate Poison had entered Jeok Cheongang’s body.

hunks.baseline: But I understood one thing clearly: the Scorching Yang Qi was acting as a breakwater and preventing the poison from spreading.
hunks.sol: But I understood one thing clearly: the Scorching Yang Qi was acting as a breakwater, holding back the spread of the poison.

hunks.baseline: “Then… then does that mean even the technique cannot cure him?”
hunks.sol: “Then… does that mean even the technique can’t cure him?”

hunks.baseline: “The Life-Restoring Great Technique can regulate his qi and untangle his disrupted qi and blood, but it is not enough to detoxify a poison like that. If we perform the technique as things stand… the Scorching Yang Qi will be calmed, but we will have no way to stop the poison.”
hunks.sol: “The Life-Restoring Great Technique can regulate his qi and untangle his disrupted qi and blood, but it is not enough to detoxify a poison like this. If we perform the technique as things stand… the Scorching Yang Qi will be calmed, but there will be nothing left to stop the poison.”

hunks.baseline: “……Young Master.”
hunks.sol: “…Young Master.”

hunks.baseline: “I know very well that the Sichuan Tang Clan is the greatest authority in the world when it comes to poison. But this poison…”
hunks.sol: “I know very well that the Sichuan Tang Clan is the greatest authority under heaven when it comes to poison. But this poison…”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, Jeok Cheongang’s body was like a cage containing two savage wolves that were keeping each other in check.
hunks.sol: Right now, Jeok Cheongang had two savage wolves inside his body, each keeping the other in check.

hunks.baseline: If either one disappeared, the other would be free to run wild.
hunks.sol: If either one disappeared, the other would regain its freedom and run wild.

hunks.baseline: *What the fuck…!*
hunks.sol: *This is so fucked…!*

hunks.baseline: Tap. Drip.
hunks.sol: Drip. Drip.

hunks.baseline: Blood fell from my tightly clenched fist. My throat burned as if I had swallowed a fireball.
hunks.sol: Drops of blood fell from my tightly clenched fist. My throat burned as though I had swallowed a fireball.

hunks.baseline: Just as I was holding back the curses that were about to burst out, someone’s voice pierced my ears.
hunks.sol: Just as I struggled to hold back the curses threatening to burst out, someone’s voice pierced my ears.

hunks.baseline: I opened my closed eyes and saw the boy’s face. Mungyeong continued with an expression more serious than I had ever seen before.
hunks.sol: I opened my eyes and saw the boy’s face. Mungyeong continued, looking more serious than I had ever seen him.

hunks.baseline: “I know, Master. I clearly remember you saying that the Tang Clan’s poison arts focus on killing, and that their detoxification techniques are lacking. But…”
hunks.sol: “I know, Master. I clearly remember you saying that the Tang Clan’s poison arts focus on killing and that their detoxification techniques are lacking. But…”

hunks.baseline: “If the Sichuan Tang Clan possesses a legendary treasure—a sacred artifact said to detoxify any poison under heaven—then it is possible.”
hunks.sol: “If the Sichuan Tang Clan possesses the legendary sacred artifact said to detoxify any poison under heaven, then it may be possible.”
